chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said:
The bread crumbs from the tablecloth are the nuptial gift for the houris.

key_terms.العِيْن: The wide-eyed ones (epithet of the houris)
key_terms.المائِدَة: The table or spread of food
key_terms.مُهُور: Plural of mahr, meaning dowry or nuptial gift

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for bread crumbs falling from the table according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, the Prophet (peace be upon him) links the mundane act of eating to eternal reward, suggesting that even the smallest crumbs falling from the table are preserved as the dowry (mahr) for the celestial maidens (Hur al-Ayn). This reflects the Shia emphasis on the sanctity of sustenance and the idea that gratitude in daily life elevates ordinary actions to spiritual merits, a concept often discussed by scholars like Al-Saduq to illustrate the interconnectedness of the material and spiritual worlds.
